Name: Achsah, Daughter of Caleb
Summary: Achsah, daughter of Caleb, married Othniel who captured Kirjath-sepher, and she asked her father for springs of water to go with her dry field.
KeyStory: Achsah boldly asked Caleb for the upper and lower springs, and he gave her both.
LifeLesson: Ask for the springs, not just the field.
